newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Trading on Kuwait Stock Exchange resumes Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Trading on Kuwait Stock Exchange resumes Tuesday.

text.p: Trading on the Kuwait Stock Exchange (KSE) will resume on Tuesday after a three-day Eid al-Fitr Moslem feast holiday which started on Saturday.

The 2-1/2 hour trading sessions will also return to the original 10 a.m. (0700 GMT) start as of Tuesday. It was pushed by one hour for a later start during the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan which ended on Friday.
For the third consecutive week, the KSE index ended the five-day trading week to Wednesday at a record high of 2,054.9 points, a rise of 30.9 points from the previous week.
